verdict.rationale: Background automations are a fair question for a cloud file-conversion SaaS, which could plausibly offer scheduled jobs, watch-folder triggers or workflow rules, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only an API, a CLI and PHP wrappers. These are developer building blocks someone could use to build their own automation, not a documented feature for setting up autonomous background workflows. Cloud-side processing is about where conversions run, not about scheduling or triggering them.
